proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellAreaOverride.relative_to_granted_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can only override a granted spell with a concrete AreaShapeSpec. This item modifies Web by reference to the spell's printed area instead of naming a new fixed shape, so a relative multiplier is needed to encode it honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."

notes: Composite magic-item structure exists for the poison resistance, linked climb speed, and once-per-dawn spell use. I did not author content because the doubled-area Web rider cannot be represented honestly with the current areaOverride shape. Spider Walk is also not surfaced cleanly: the current prototype treats web terrain / web-specific movement geometry as caller-owned, so that rider would remain omitted even after the spell-cast gap is addressed.
